statement: The proposed idea is already executed in the retrieved literature by arxiv:2609.12230 (Fonseka and Jha, 2026), which shares all three components: same-source-chunk context triples attached to each primary triple with a KG-grounded versus CG-grounded supervision comparison, an adaptive repair loop over detected one-hop failures with targeted corrective examples and quarantine, and RL on lower-hop items evaluated for generalization to 3/4/5-hop. The remaining differences are implementation-level (SapBERT-similarity context selection, Qwen3-14B with LoRA, GRPO with path-alignment reward, biomedical multiple-choice synthetic data).
